value.rationale: The distance-transitive bipartite Kneser/crown family has a natural full S_n×C2 action. Its complete integral homotopy classification and integral exterior-square representation expose new all-order topology, show both natural orbit spaces contractible, and yield a pure nonshellable cube case. Those consequences are motivated by intrinsic symmetries and missing matching edges, not arbitrary numerical slices.
